thread:
sara: heads-up — staged deploy to rollout-service failed during preflight. saw repeated errors from the kep-gate call: `403: KMS access denied` when trying to unwrap the canary key. not user-facing yet but blocks all canary traffic :lock: 

jon: wait is this the same SA we updated last week in the rbac refactor? :thinking_face:

leo: yep — rollout-sa got its roles renamed (`rollout.exec` -> `rollout.executor`) in the migration but i don't think the IAM binding for the KMS key was migrated. saw an audit entry: `iam.policy: removed binding serviceAccount:rollout-sa -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` around the same time.

deploy-bot: [alert] staged-deploy/1723 failed preflight check (code=KMS_DENIED). run `redwoodctl deploy status --id 1723` for more details.

eva: how is the gating logic wired? i thought fallback to `route-fallback` kicks in on any auth error so app keeps serving with reduced capacity. if KMS denied caused a hard error, the fallback logic might be short-circuited.

sara: gating lives in gatekeeper; sequence is: 1) gatekeeper fetches encryption metadata from key-manager (requires KMS decrypt), 2) calls authz-service to check rollout permissions, 3) if OK, advance canary. the bug looks like the KMS error happens before we ever evaluate the `fallback.enabled` flag, so fallback never runs.

jon: can you paste the failing stack/log snippet?

sara: sure — full line: ```
2026-03-19T21:12:02Z gatekeeper[pid=8] ERROR canary_preflight: kms.Decrypt failed project=my-proj key=projects/my-proj/locations/global/keyRings/rollout/cryptoKeys/canary-key error="Permission denied: serviceAccount:rollout-sa@my-proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com lacks roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter" correlation_id=cf7e3c2e
```

leo: that correlation_id is present in the audit logs (thanks audit-bot). audit-bot: ```
2026-03-19T21:12:03Z audit-bot INFO iam.audit: policy_change actor=infra-ci@redwood.internal removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from rollout-sa correlation_id=cf7e3c2e
```

eva: ok two things: immediate mitigation and long-term fix. immediate: add the KMS decrypt role back to rollout-sa scoped to the canary key and re-trigger the staged deploy. long-term: we need a migration that maps old role names to new role names and re-applies any resource-scoped bindings (KMS, PubSub, etc). also add a unit/integration test that simulates missing KMS perms and verifies fallback path executes.

sara: putting up a hotfix now — PR incoming to infra-ops to rebind the key. i'll also manually re-run the staged deploy once infra confirms binding.

jon: i'll own the migration PR. plan: scan org for bindings referencing the old role, map to new role, run a dry-run diff and then apply. include a `--safe` mode that prompts for KMS key-level bindings.

leo: also want to add a safety net in gatekeeper: if KMS decrypt fails, mark `preflight_error` but still evaluate `fallback.enabled` via a cached metadata path so customers don't go fully dark. we can gate that behind a feature flag.

eva: and we must make sure every auth decision is logged to the audit pipeline with the correlation_id and `auth_decision` field. missing debug-level audit entries made triage slow here. ticket: https://redwood.internal/issue/SEC-3321 (add correlation_id to gatekeeper/audit events).

deploy-bot: [info] hotfix PR opened: infra-ops/patches#582, author=sara, summary=Rebind KMS decrypt role for rollout-sa (canary).

audit-bot: [info] created audit trail SEC-3321: attached logs for correlation_id=cf7e3c2e and policy diff snapshot.

sara: follow-up actions i will track: 1) confirm hotfix applied and staged deploy re-run (ETA 30m), 2) postmortem with timeline, 3) RFC for role-mapping migration, 4) add gatekeeper fallback test + audit logging. assigning owners in the ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:

jon: when hotfix is done, let's do a quick org-wide query for other service accounts that had `rollout.exec` -> `rollout.executor` rename and check KMS bindings. i suspect at least 3 more.

leo: will add a lint rule to the infra CI that fails if role renames without key-level bindings are detected.

eva: nice. marking SEC-3321 high-priority. please paste the staged-deploy run id after re-trigger so SRE can watch latency and error metrics.

sara: will update thread after verification. :eyes:
